summary: Async button: a promise from onClick shows a pixel spinner, then a drawn check or a shake with "Try again", and returns to its label after 1.8 s.

props.name: variant
props.description: `default` is the accent button, `secondary` a bordered surface button, `danger` uses the destructive colour.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows the loading state while true, for loading driven from outside. Turning it on calls `onStart`; turning it off returns to the label.

props.name: type
props.description: Native button type. `submit` submits its form, except while loading.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler. When it returns a promise, the button runs it like `run()`. Not called while loading.

props.name: onStart
props.description: Called when the loading state begins.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called with the rejection reason when the task fails.

methods.description: Shows the loading state while `task` runs, then the success or error state for 1.8 s before returning to the label. Resolves with the task's result or rethrows its error. It does not check `disabled`.

accessibility: A native `<button>`; its accessible name is the visible label.
The label is an `aria-live="polite"` region, so the loading, success and error texts are announced.
motion: With reduced motion the label swaps without rolling and the error shake is skipped; the pixel spinner and check still draw.
form: A native button. With `type="submit"` a click submits its form, which runs validation; clicks while loading neither submit nor call `onClick`.
notes: The label rolls between states, so `children` is a string, not markup.
The root carries `data-state` set to `loading`, `success` or `error` outside the idle state, and `data-variant`.
`ref` is the handle, not the DOM button.
In the success state the label and the check are a near-black shade of `--lumesec-success`, which keeps at least 4.5:1 contrast on the green fill in light and dark themes.
